title: ACPI Sleep States
description: Uses ACPI S-states from S0 working through S3 suspend to S4 hibernate. S3 keeps RAM powered for instant resume; S4 writes RAM to disk and powers off fully. The OS picks the state matching the expected sleep duration.
key_mechanisms: Use S4 hibernate for long sleeps

demo.title: Demo — ACPI Sleep States

title: CPU P-States and C-States
description: Scales CPU frequency with P-states and parks idle cores in deep C-states. P-states trade speed for power; C-states cut idle power to near zero at microsecond wake costs. The governor balances the two continuously.
key_mechanisms: Park idle cores in deep C-states
Tune the governor for the workload

demo.title: Demo — CPU P-States and C-States

title: Tickless Idle
description: Stops the periodic timer tick when the CPU is idle so cores sleep uninterrupted. The old 1000 Hz tick woke every core every millisecond; tickless kernels sleep until the next real event. It is why modern laptops idle efficiently.
key_mechanisms: Disable the periodic tick when idle
Account time from TSC on wake

demo.title: Demo — Tickless Idle

title: Runtime Power Management
description: Suspends individual devices at runtime when idle, independent of system sleep. USB, PCIe, and SATA devices each get autosuspend policies; the framework tracks usage counts. It saves power while the system stays fully usable.

demo.title: Demo — Runtime Power Management

title: Battery Charge Thresholds
description: Limits maximum charge to 80 percent to extend battery lifespan. Lithium batteries degrade fastest at full charge and high temperature; thresholds trade a little capacity for years of health. Business laptops ship this by default.
key_mechanisms: Set the charge limit in firmware

demo.title: Demo — Battery Charge Thresholds

title: Adaptive Display Brightness
description: Dims the display to ambient light because the screen dominates power draw. The ambient sensor drives a brightness curve tuned for readability at minimum power. It is the single biggest lever on phone battery life.

demo.title: Demo — Adaptive Display Brightness

title: Radio Power Gating
description: Powers down Wi-Fi, cellular, and Bluetooth radios when not in use. Radios burn power just listening; gating them during idle and batching transfers cuts the biggest phone power sink. Airplane mode is the manual version.

demo.title: Demo — Radio Power Gating

title: Wake Lock Discipline
description: Manages wake locks so apps cannot keep the device awake indefinitely. Every lock needs a timeout and a justification; the system releases forgotten locks. Runaway wake locks are the classic battery-drain bug.

demo.title: Demo — Wake Lock Discipline

title: Hibernation to Disk
description: Writes RAM to disk and powers off fully for zero-draw sleep. Resume restores the exact session; modern NVMe makes it nearly as fast as suspend. It is the answer for multi-day standby.
key_mechanisms: Compress and write RAM to disk

demo.title: Demo — Hibernation to Disk

title: Energy-Aware Scheduling
description: Places tasks on the most energy-efficient core that meets their deadline. The scheduler models each core's energy cost and picks the cheapest fit; little cores handle background work. It is the OS side of heterogeneous computing.
key_mechanisms: Place tasks on the cheapest fit

demo.title: Demo — Energy-Aware Scheduling

title: Battery Health Modeling
description: Models battery degradation from charge cycles, temperature, and voltage to predict remaining lifespan. Coulomb counting plus voltage curves estimate state of health; the OS surfaces it to users. It drives charge-threshold policies.

demo.title: Demo — Battery Health Modeling

title: USB Power Delivery Negotiation
description: Negotiates voltage and current over USB-C Power Delivery for efficient charging. The sink requests what it needs; the source advertises capabilities. Correct negotiation avoids both slow charging and overheating.

demo.title: Demo — USB Power Delivery Negotiation

title: Low-Power Audio Paths
description: Routes audio through low-power DSP paths that sip power during playback. The main CPU sleeps while the DSP decodes; hardware offload cuts music-playback drain dramatically. It is why phones play music for days.

demo.title: Demo — Low-Power Audio Paths

title: Display Refresh Scaling
description: Varies display refresh rate with content: 120 Hz for scrolling, 1 Hz for static reading. The display pipeline burns power per frame; adaptive refresh cuts frames nobody sees. LTPO panels make it seamless.

demo.title: Demo — Display Refresh Scaling

title: Power Budgeting
description: Allocates a system power budget across CPU, GPU, and radios so the total never exceeds the thermal or battery limit. The budgeter arbitrates competing demands in real time. It is how thin devices sustain peak bursts safely.

demo.title: Demo — Power Budgeting
